name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Siegbert Frank Droese
part_text:
The European Parliament is lifting the legal protection from prosecution that Siegbert Frank Droese, a German member, holds as an elected representative. A German court has convicted him of insult and fined him, and he is appealing. The court asked Parliament for permission to continue the appeal. Parliament agreed, so the case can go ahead. The acts happened before he became a member and were not part of his parliamentary work.

- A German member loses his protection from prosecution, so his insult case can proceed.
- It affects Siegbert Frank Droese and the German court handling his appeal.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to the German authorities and to him.
